sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Visa’s durable global payments network combined with an operating margin of [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] supports a Buy recommendation. The high margin reflects strong pricing power and an efficient cost structure. A key risk is ongoing regulatory and litigation scrutiny of interchange fees that could pressure transaction volume and pricing power [source:K:L441]. The recommendation would shift to Hold or Sell if the operating margin were to deteriorate markedly or if regulatory actions materially reduced transaction volumes.

insight.text: The debt‑to‑equity ratio of [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]] indicates moderate leverage, providing financial flexibility for continued investment and strategic acquisitions.
